verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials is a fair question for an observability platform with REST APIs, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers API keys, roles, privilege scoping or credential issuance. The 'Elastic Agent' and Fleet items are about telemetry-collection agents, not credentials for an AI agent, and get no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
